expectations.name: 01-page-written
expectations.text: A feature page under docs/features/ is written or changed, the kind the map gives a unit of behavior.

expectations.name: 02-structure
expectations.text:
Each page the agent wrote or changed meets the map's structural rules: a declared kind, listed in its guide, links
and anchors that resolve, the kind's sections in order, a record named NNNN-<slug>.md, no rejected synonym.

expectations.name: 03-lead
expectations.text: Each feature page written or changed opens with a lead under its title, not a restatement of the title.

expectations.name: 04-reason-told
expectations.text:
The page says why members cannot cancel within 2 hours of pickup, told as it happened: late cancellations after
packing left bags of fresh food to spoil, not only a conclusion such as "to reduce waste".
expectations.evidence: "Late cancellations had left packed bags on the shelf for three Saturdays in a row; a banner asking members to cancel earlier had been in place since summer, but 25 bags of fresh food were thrown away in October." together with "Members may cancel before packing starts, two hours before their pickup slot" tells the story of the cutoff, not just a conclusion.

expectations.name: 05-fact-stated
expectations.text: The page states the cutoff: 2 hours before the pickup slot starts.
